title: Weapon Internalization
summary: Cybernetic enhancement, commercial You gain the ability to internalize a nontechnical weapon of your choice into one of your limbs, negating the need to stow and switch weapons, and removing the threat of being disarmed.
markdown:
*Cybernetic enhancement, commercial*

You gain the ability to internalize a nontechnical weapon of your choice into one of your limbs, negating the need to stow and switch weapons, and removing the threat of being disarmed.
